text_block_list.text:
The day of Mejiro Dober's Debut race. 
Mejiro Bright, Mejiro Ryan, and Air Groove 
have all rushed over to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eager to answer everyone's cheers, Mejiro 
Dober heads into her Debut race burning 
with fighting spirit.
